column1: # LIVE A LIVE: Square Enix / historia, Unreal Engine 4, SDK 12.3.2, NVN, Wwise sound;
# Unreal Engine 4 + SDK 12.3.2 (same sdk/subsdk0 build IDs as OCTOPATH TRAVELER II):
# rewriter cuts FMallocBinned3 (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and scales the engine region to the alias region (dm/tools/ue_region.py).
# PEANUTS begin: 60 fps (30 on Switch). Host patches Unreal t.MaxFPS=60 and rhi.SyncInterval=1.
# Verified on OnePlus 13R (Turnip T30 and Qualcomm 512.762.41 with DM_VK_PSO_ASYNC=0): locked 60 fps at 1x speed.
# PEANUTS begin: prefer installed Turnip on Qualcomm drivers before 512.800 (driverID 8, major 512, minor < 800).
# Measured on OnePlus 13R (Adreno 750, Qualcomm 512.762.41 / 0x802fa029): with DM_VK_PREWARM=0 forced on < 512.800,
# default DM_VK_PSO_ASYNC=2 washes out title lighting on both cold and warm starts and hit SIGSEGV in vulkan.adreno.so+0x1f3a48
# entering Twilight of Edo Japan. Turnip T30 runs 60 fps cleanly once warm (or with DM_VK_PSO_ASYNC=0 on cold start); see README.md.
# PEANUTS begin: test pso_async=off recommendation on cold start (see README.md).
